section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Drive for Muscularity Scale (DMS), a 16-item instrument used to measure men's desire for a more muscular body. The text explains that the DMS was administered in the present study using a Malay translation, with items rated on a 6-point scale and reverse-coded so higher scores indicate greater drive for muscularity. The section reports that the Malay version of the DMS demonstrated good internal consistency (omega = .88) in the present study.
